_notes: Automation data per item; every item's text is its entry in Corgo's document. Per item: kind ('cyberware' = a cyberware Item, 'enhancement' = an itemUpgrade of type cyberware, 'cyberdeck' = a cyberdeck Item); type = CPR cyberware subtype; foundational/size/slots follow core's convention (size = option slots the piece consumes, slots = option slots it provides); effects = [key, value] or [key, value, mode] (mode 2 = add, 4 = raise to at least, 5 = override), situational effects become toggles in the roll dialog; mods = itemUpgrade modifiers (slots, magazine, attackmod, ...); weapon = isWeapon stats; split = one item per variant.
